ai-assisted-development.description:
I am familiar with AI-assisted development, including agent and subagent workflows, sequential and concurrent flows, and worktrees for parallel work.

I also work with skills and plugins, context optimization, cost reduction, and tuning feedback loops so agents can verify their own work.
ai-assisted-development.title: AI-assisted development

frontend-architecture.description:
I have experience with hexagonal architecture (ports and adapters), with strict boundaries and an acyclic dependency graph automatically verified with dependency-cruiser.

I also have experience with frontend monorepos with pnpm and Turborepo, component libraries with Storybook, and multiple build modes.
frontend-architecture.title: Frontend architecture and platform

react.description:
I understand how rendering and reconciliation work, and I build reusable and efficient components that reduce the number of required renders.

I have experience with various React libraries, such as React Redux, Redux-Saga, TanStack Query, and React Hook Form.

typescript.description:
I have experience with TypeScript in the areas of type safety and ergonomics, implementing solutions that balance these factors to increase development agility and reduce the incidence of bugs.

I am comfortable with concepts such as structural typing, set theory as applied to types, covariance and contravariance, generic types, and type inference.
